newsitem.title: UK: UK meals and feeds lower, but trade remains thin.
newsitem.headline: UK meals and feeds lower, but trade remains thin.

text.p: Asking prices on the UK meals and feeds market were around one to two stg down on Tuesday following the lower close in Chicago, but buyers saw no need to chase the market.
"Most people are covered and with Chicago coming down they are even less likely to buy," said one broker.
Brokers said there were a few odds and ends being traded but nothing worthwhile.
Soymeal was said to be trading within one stg of the asking prices for spot through to April, but trade was mostly hand-to-mouth.
Citrus pulp pellets fetched 75 stg a tonne for spot ex-store Liverpool while on the resale market Cargill rapemeal traded at 121.50 for spot.
